parsed.summary: The PR addresses a precision issue with the floatformat filter for Decimal numbers but may introduce regressions or non-minimal changes.

issues.description: The change from repr(text) to str(text) may break existing behavior for other types or formats that rely on the previous representation.
The change is not minimal as it affects the conversion of all inputs to strings, potentially impacting performance or introducing new issues.
There are no additional tests provided to ensure the change does not introduce new regressions or handle other edge cases.
